newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Dyno nine-month profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dyno nine-month profits seen down.

text.p: Norwegian explosives and chemicals group Dyno Industrier ASA is expected to book profits before tax of about 291 million crowns for the first nine months of the year, according to a Reuter poll of six analysts.
In the corresponding 1995 period the company posted a pre-tax profit of 486 million crowns.
Four of the analysts recommended a hold on Dyno while two said buy.

The biggest risk to the downside for Dyno remained low margins, especially in explosives and chemicals, the analysts said. However, many of them expected an improved performance in Dyno's explosives business.

"If the company can show in the third quarter results a significant impact from restructuring and a higher level of activity in explosives, I would be willing to upgrade to buy," said one of the analysts.
Others said restructuring of explosives had already been discounted in the share price.
On Monday Dyno was trading six crowns up at 156.50 crowns in thin volume.
Dyno will present nine-month results at 0630 GMT on October 18. Following lists analysts' expectations.
